newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Anhyp had 428 million 1996 cons loss.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Anhyp had 428 million 1996 cons loss.

text.p: Belgian bank Anhyp said in a statement on Friday that it booked a 428 million franc consolidated loss in 1996. It gave no comparative figures.

It added that its 1996 accounts included capital losses worth 3.2 billion francs on real estate, capital gains worth 1.5 billion francs on the sale of state debt securities and 921 million francs worth of charges related to a restructuring plan.
The bank, which has been the focus of takeover talk for the past two years, mentioned nothing about potential partnership talks in its statement.
It said that interest income rose to 5.88 billion francs from 4.88 billion in 1995.
Its Risk Asset Ratio rose to 12.47 percent at the end of 1996 from from 11.55 percent at the end of 1995.
